headline: Govt to recruit 10,000 police constables to boost security
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman announced the plan during the closing speech of the second session of the National Parliament.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has announced a plan to recruit 10,000 new police constables to make the law enforcement agencies more professional and effective.
The announcement was made during the closing speech of the second session and the first budget session of the National Parliament on Wednesday, July 15, 2026.
The Prime Minister stated that the government is working to build a modern and professional police force to ensure the safety and security of the citizens.
He emphasized that the government aims to create a Bangladesh where the state and government are accountable to the people, the economy is inclusive, and every citizen's life is safe and dignified.
Additionally, the Prime Minister announced a program to plant 250 million trees over the next five years through government and voluntary efforts to protect the environment and create employment.
caption:

The Prime Minister stated that the government is working to build a modern and professional police force to ensure the safety and security of the citizens.

He emphasized that the government aims to create a Bangladesh where the state and government are accountable to the people, the economy is inclusive, and every citizen's life is safe and dignified.

Additionally, the Prime Minister announced a program to plant 250 million trees over the next five years through government and voluntary efforts to protect the environment and create employment.

headline: 4 madrasa students drown in Narsingdi
summary: The children, all students of Gausia Nure Madina Female Madrasa, died after going for a swim in a canal in Raipura.
details: Four children drowned in a canal in Boro Kanda village of Chanderkandi Union, Raipura Upazila, Narsingdi on Thursday afternoon.
The victims are Tabia (13), Aisha (9), Jannat (8), and Sumaiya (10). All four were students of the local Gausia Nure Madina Female Madrasa.
According to police and local sources, six students went for a swim in a nearby canal during their madrasa break. Four of them sank, while two managed to reach the shore and alert locals.
Local residents rescued the four children from the water. One child died at the scene, while the other three passed away on the way to Raipura Upazila Health Complex.
Dr. Ashraful Rahman of the health complex's emergency department confirmed that three children were brought in dead, with no heartbeat detected.
Raipura Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Mojibur Rahman stated that legal measures will be taken after discussions with the families of the deceased.
caption:
Four children, all students of a female madrasa, drowned in a canal in Narsingdi during their school break.

Four children drowned in a canal in Boro Kanda village of Chanderkandi Union, Raipura Upazila, Narsingdi on Thursday afternoon.

The victims are Tabia (13), Aisha (9), Jannat (8), and Sumaiya (10). All four were students of the local Gausia Nure Madina Female Madrasa.

According to police and local sources, six students went for a swim in a nearby canal during their madrasa break. Four of them sank, while two managed to reach the shore and alert locals.

Local residents rescued the four children from the water. One child died at the scene, while the other three passed away on the way to Raipura Upazila Health Complex.

Dr. Ashraful Rahman of the health complex's emergency department confirmed that three children were brought in dead, with no heartbeat detected.

Raipura Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Mojibur Rahman stated that legal measures will be taken after discussions with the families of the deceased.
